whatsNew: Survives trouble: reconnects with backoff (even a stuck DAVE handshake), one in-character apology per failure type instead of silence or loops, leaves after 5 min alone
start.ps1 starts the speech sidecar and the bot in one command and stops both together
Privacy: logs redact keys, transcripts only appear at LOG_LEVEL=debug, no audio is written to disk; optional /mirror posts heard/said lines to a text channel
whatToTry: Locally: .\start.ps1, /join, then kill and restart the sidecar mid-call and watch it recover
Try /mirror on in a text channel (off by default)
